design.native: Implicit actual-cell lvalue constructor borrows a live const volatile int32 cell. At equality zero uses the existing unsigned UTF16 ASCII loop; nonzero delegates to existing GuiTextContentCalls native-current service.
design.Source_current: Explicit source_current(function,context) factory preflights a nonnull callback; stores no cell; every reached nonempty equality delegates to that callback at the equality point.
design.state: Private mutually exclusive actual_changed_cell_ or source_current_/source_context_; no default constructor, default service, cell snapshot, locale-name cache or process owner.
design.preflight: Missing Source-current callback throws invalid_argument at view construction. Host requires legacy comparator only in borrowed-cell mode; Source-current host mode may leave it null.
design.unexpected_native_call: Host explicitly throws logic_error if its unused unbound native callback is directly invoked; no alternate comparer or fallback is installed.
design.temporary_cells: int32 rvalue construction deleted; only live actual lvalue cells are admitted by native construction.
design.Source_ABI: Reference field became a comparison value and member names changed; existing positional native aggregate values convert implicitly. Named-member/precompiled consumers need migration/rebuild.

propagation.host: Copies the same comparison value into content; native-call preflight observes that mode.
propagation.runtime_refs: GuiTextRuntimeContentServices already borrows content; no further propagation required.

exact_seam.empty_gates: stored empty -> copied empty; copied empty with nonempty stored -> false; neither mode invokes comparer.
exact_seam.nonempty: No wrapper-length-equality shortcut; delegate exact live stored.c_str()/copied.c_str() pointers.

limits: Explicit callback supplies its current Source semantics and owns its synchronization and borrowed lifetime contract.
No actual UCRT adapter/provider was added or compared, and no locale setter is called.
Modern host substitution does not prove Original-entry, Original locale/PTD type, non-C Unicode/version, SEH or game equivalence.
